metadata.disclaimer: NOTE: This analysis reports an associational relationship (correlation) between emotional consistency and user trust. These results are non-causal and do not imply that changes in emotional consistency cause changes in trust. Confounding variables and reverse causality cannot be ruled out without controlled experimental intervention.

robustness_check.interpretation: Associational robustness check controlling for covariates.
